_note: What you see: The house style of the Warmtepompacademie: petrol and glow, Barlow, the temperature line under the header and above the footer, and the corners of website and workspace.
_note_nl: Wat je ziet: De huisstijl van de Warmtepompacademie: petrol en gloed, Barlow, de temperatuurlijn onder de kop en boven de voet, en de hoeken van website en werkplek.
Eén thema in thematiq kleurt de website: One theme in thematiq colours the website with the course catalogue, My academy for participants and employers, and the Nextcloud workspace of planning, trainers and administration.
Lettertypen: Barlow en Barlow Semi Conde: Typefaces: Barlow and Barlow Semi Condensed (open licence)
Een warmtepomp haalt warmte uit koude lu: A heat pump takes heat from cold air or cold ground and brings it inside. The line shows that in five hard steps, from petrol to glow. No gradient: an installer reads off settings.
Petrol is voor wat u kunt doen: knoppen: Petrol is for what you can do: buttons and links.
Gloed wijst aan waar u bent en wat nieuw: Glow points to where you are and what is new.
De lijn sluit de kop af en opent de voet: The line closes the header and opens the footer. Nowhere else.
Verder blijft de pagina wit. De inhoud i: The rest of the page stays white. The content is a date, a place, a price and a certificate.
Vijf vlakken in de verhouding 8, 3, 2, 3: Five surfaces in the ratio 8, 3, 2, 3, 8. In use the line is 5 px high and runs the full width. The two in-between shades appear only in the line.
De koude kant. Knoppen, links, focus: The cold side. Buttons, links, focus
Hover, voettekst, tekst op petrol licht: Hover, footer, text on light petrol
Informatie, datumtegel, plek voor een fo: Information, date tile, place for a photo
De warme kant. Badge \"nieuw\", markerin: The warm side. Badge "new", highlight with text
Alleen als markering: logo, temperatuurl: Only as a highlight: logo, temperature line, stripe under the active menu item. Never under text
Lopende tekst · Barlow 18 px. U regelt e: Body text · Barlow 18 px. You balance an outdoor unit, find a fault and fill in the logbook.
Koppen en cijfers staan in Barlow Semi C: Headings and figures are in Barlow Semi Condensed: narrow and straight, like the letters on a rating plate.
Knoppen zijn petrol, met hoeken van 3 px: Buttons are petrol, with corners of 3 px. Glow is never a button: an orange surface always means you are here, or this is new.
Waar volgt u de cursus?: Where do you take the course?
Het examen is op dezelfde dag, in de mid: The exam is on the same day, in the afternoon.
De inschrijving is bevestigd. Drie plekk: The enrolment is confirmed. Three places are fixed.
Het inschrijven lukte niet. Probeer het: Enrolling did not work. Try again in a few minutes.
Op de website zijn labels recht, net als: On the website labels are square, like the buttons. On the workspace they are round Cunningham pills, in the same colours.
De datumtegel is het vaste begin van elk: The date tile is the fixed start of every course row: on the website, in My academy and in the planning.
Op wit: website, Mijn academie, e-mails,: On white: website, My academy, emails, certificates
Kop, voet, inlogscherm, favicon, certifi: Header, footer, sign-in screen, favicon, certificate
vast onderdeel van kop en voet in portal: fixed part of header and footer in portaliq: five colours and their ratio
